criteria.description: Assesses whether the difference is statistically significant and conveys uncertainty (confidence interval / plausible range), not just comparing the two point estimates.
Catches the early-stopping/peeking problem ('looked significant on day 2') and the very short 5-day run as reasons to distrust a premature call.
Flags the lower revenue-per-order as a guardrail concern — a higher purchase rate may not be a net win if revenue drops — rather than ignoring it.
Considers whether the test is adequately powered / has enough sample, rather than treating the result as definitive.
Gives a clear, reasoned ship/iterate/stop/extend recommendation with the risk of being wrong, not just a description of the numbers.
